Benchmarks

MTRAG, MTRAGEval, CORAL, RAD-Bench, SemEval 2026 Task 8 - 842-turn multi-turn benchmark, nDCG@5, RAGAS, human evaluation, automated eval

## Benchmark Landscape ### MTRAG: The Gold Standard (ACL 2025) | Aspect | Detail | |--------|--------| | **Paper** | MTRAG: A Multi-Turn Conversational Benchmark for Evaluating Retrieval-Augmented Generation Systems (Katsis et al., ACL 2025) | | **Repository** | https://github.com/ibm/mt-rag-benchmark | | **Conversations** | 110 human-generated | | **Turns** | 842 total (7.7 avg/conv) | | **Domains** | ClapNQ (26.6%), FiQA (23.6%), Govt (25.4%), Cloud (24.4%) | | **Answerable** | 777 turns (after filtering unanswerable) | | **Passages/Conv** | 16.9 unique relevant | **Key Finding**: ELSER R@5 drops **0.89 → 0.47** (first → later turns) = **51% degradation** --- ### MTRAGEval: SemEval 2026 Task 8 | Subtask | Description | Metric | |---------|-------------|--------| | **Task A** | Retrieval | nDCG@1/3/5/10, Recall@1/3/5/10 | | **Task B** | Generation with gold passages | Quality | | **Task C** | End-to-end RAG | Harmonic mean (quality + faithfulness, IDK-conditioned) | **Domains**: ClapNQ (26.6%), FiQA (23.6%), Govt (25.4%), Cloud (24.4%) **Top Results (Task A)**: | Team | nDCG@5 | Rank | |------|--------|------| | Sifei | 0.5453 | 3/38 | | GUIR | 0.5453 | 3/38 | | uva-irlab | - | - | --- ### Other Benchmarks | Benchmark | Description | Key Metric | |-----------|-------------|------------| | **CORAL** (2025) | Conversational retrieval with cross-turn evidence | nDCG@5 | | **RAD-Bench** (2024) | Retrieval and reasoning across dialogue turns | Accuracy | | **Qulac/ClariQ** | Clarification datasets (10k+ queries) | Facet coverage | --- ## Our 41-Turn Benchmark Results ### Overall Metrics (Before vs After) | Metric | Before (2026-10-12) | After (2026-10-14) | Δ | |--------|---------------------|--------------------|---| | **Finish mismatches** | 6/41 | **0/41** | -6 | | **Retrieval hit** | 0.537 | **0.780** | **+0.243** | | **Cheque hit** | 0.111 | **0.667** | **+0.556** | | **Context recall** | 0.113 | **0.340** | **+0.227** | | **Answer relevancy** | 0.212 | **0.568** | **+0.356** | | **Ambiguity resolution** | 0.854 (0/6) | **1.000** (6/6) | **+0.146** | | **Sticky persistence** | 0.610 | **0.683** | +0.073 | | **Hallucination** | 0.195 | **0.254** | +0.059 (tradeoff) | | **p50 latency** | 8006ms | **4872ms** | **-39%** | ### Subspace Breakdown (After Fixes) | Subspace | Count | Hit | Faith | Sticky | p50 | |----------|-------|-----|-------|--------|-----| | Cheque | 9 | 0.667 | 0.422 | 0.444 | 10301ms | | Facilities Person | 6 | 0.500 | 0.967 | 0.667 | 10718ms | | Facilities Legal | 3 | 0.667 | 0.917 | 0.333 | 10498ms | | General | 10 | 0.800 | 0.655 | 0.600 | 6981ms | --- ## Reproduction ```bash # Full benchmark (214s) cd Work_Credit-RAG_Phase1 PYTHONPATH=".:components/orchestrator:$PYTHONPATH" python3 -m evaluation.bench_runner # RAGAS evaluation PYTHONPATH=".:components/orchestrator:$PYTHONPATH" python3 -m evaluation.ragas_eval \ --input evaluation/artifacts/bench_results_latest.json \ --output evaluation/artifacts/ragas_results_latest.json # Report generation PYTHONPATH=".:components/orchestrator:$PYTHONPATH" python3 -m evaluation.report \ --bench evaluation/artifacts/bench_results_latest.json \ --ragas evaluation/artifacts/ragas_results_latest.json \ --out evaluation/artifacts/bench_report_latest.html ``` --- ##
